newsitem.title: USA: Bellwether stake held by Torchmark.
newsitem.headline: Bellwether stake held by Torchmark.

text.p: Torchmark Corp said on Tuesday it and a unit hold an 8.2 percent stake in Bellwether Exploration Co.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Torchmark said its unit, United Investors Management Co, received Bellwether securities as an intercompany dividend before Torch Energy Advisors Inc was sold by United to its current owners on September 30.
The securities consisted of 562,696 common shares and warrants to buy an additional 187,500 shares, Torchmark said.
Torchmark, an insurance holding company based in Birmingham, Ala., said it and United hold the stake for investment.
Bellwether is a Houston-based oil exploration and production company.
